args.prompt: Game character turnaround reference. The dark rider stands perfectly still in a neutral idle pose on an invisible turntable and rotates a full 360 degrees at a constant speed, turning to show his left side, then his back, then his right side, then front again. Locked-off camera, slightly elevated looking down, no camera movement, no zoom, no perspective change. Plain flat white background, even soft lighting. The design stays exactly identical: armoured dark knight on a black armoured warhorse: dark iron great helm with tall spikes and a glowing purple visor slit, spiked pauldrons, dark plate armour, a long tattered charcoal cape, a long dark iron halberd held upright in his right hand; the horse black with dark iron barding on its head, neck and chest, a glowing purple eye, a short dark mane, a long dark tail, standing square on all four hooves. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: the purple glow of his visor and of the horse's eye keeps exactly the same brightness and colour in every frame, no glow, no halo. Crisp sharp detail in every frame, no motion blur, no ghosting, no walking, no text.

The dark rider stays exactly centered, does not turn, move or change size. Locked-off camera, no zoom, plain flat white background, even lighting, crisp frames, no motion blur.
